title: A lookup table
description:
Some data never changes: the number of days in each month, for instance. A `constexpr std::array` holds it without any `if` or `switch`.

Write `int daysIn(int month)` (month 1 to 12, not a leap year) by looking the answer up in a `constexpr std::array<int, 12>`. Months outside 1 to 12 return `-1`.
rules: Use a `std::array` as the lookup table.
No `switch` this time: look the answer up.
